children: Global Health Care AG proposes selling up to 100% of milon Holding GmbH at a €23.3M equity value. The company expects approximately €4.3M in cash plus subscription-right payments, and liabilities to decrease by up to approximately €4.1M; shareholders vote on 14 December 2026.
Up to 100% of milon proposed for sale
The proposed disposal would exit the asset; completion depends on approval at the extraordinary General Meeting.
Includes a €13.5M valuation and waiver of €9.8M in shareholder loans; no prior-period comparison was provided.
This is before payments from subscription rights; proceeds are intended to settle company liabilities.
Liabilities may fall by up to approximately €4.1M
Debt relief is expected through loan offsets, but the amount is capped and conditional on the proposed transaction.
The sale remains a proposal until the extraordinary General Meeting; subscription rights can be exercised only there.

This is a concrete proposed asset sale, supplementing the company's 18 November 2026 announcement, rather than a completed transaction. Approval at the 14 December 2026 extraordinary General Meeting and the resulting sale and subscription-right payments would determine the realized cash and liability reduction.
from Global Health Care AG distributed by EQS.
